loops.description: Clarify one initiative's human-owned intent, stakeholders, scope, constraints and measurable quality scenarios into an approved BRIEF.

state.description: Arc42MethodStateV1 bounded references shared by every arc42 Loop in the Root Run.

nodes.description: Create or update the initiative BRIEF with goals, stakeholders, scope, non-goals, constraints and context.

work.task: Create or update `.ballet/arc42/initiatives/<initiative-id>/BRIEF.md` from accepted Goals, ADRs and explicit human input. Separate Fact, Decision, Assumption, Hypothesis, Finding and Open question. Return needs_input instead of inventing missing WHAT/WHY, priority or ownership.

validation.task: Validate that the BRIEF is bounded, source-linked and explicit about stakeholders, scope, non-goals, constraints, context and every unresolved human decision. Do not edit it.

nodes.description: Define top quality goals and complete measurable quality scenarios with explicit human authority.

work.task: Define or update the initiative's measurable quality scenarios and trace them to accepted Goal/Requirement IDs. Every scenario must contain all section 10 fields. Ask for human input when priority or acceptance measure is missing.

validation.task: Approve the initiative WHAT/WHY, scope, priority and measurable quality-scenario criteria, or return FAIL with the exact missing decision/correction. Do not approve an invented or unmeasurable criterion.

loops.description: Design solution strategy, building blocks, interfaces and significant runtime/deployment scenarios for an approved initiative.

state.description: Arc42MethodStateV1 bounded references shared by every arc42 Loop in the Root Run.

nodes.description: Update the quality-driven solution strategy for the bounded initiative.

work.task: Update arc42 section 4 and initiative planning references with the smallest solution strategy that satisfies the approved BRIEF and priority quality scenarios. Record unresolved significant choices explicitly.

validation.task: Validate the solution strategy against the BRIEF, constraints and measurable quality scenarios without editing the proposal.

nodes.description: Maintain the Building Block View with source and interface mappings.

work.task: Update arc42 section 5. For every relevant building block state responsibility, interfaces, quality significance, source location, implemented requirements and open risks; map blocks to actual directories and shared interfaces.

validation.task: Validate that building-block ownership, interfaces, source mappings, QS trace and risks match the repository and approved strategy. Do not edit the view.

nodes.description: Update only architecturally significant runtime and deployment scenarios.

work.task: Update arc42 sections 6 and 7 only for important, risky or complex runtime/deployment scenarios. Link interactions to building blocks, interfaces, QS IDs, source locations and evidence expectations.

validation.task: Validate that the selected scenarios are architecture-significant, consistent with building blocks and sufficient for the in-scope quality scenarios. Do not add scenarios.

loops.description: Design quality-driven crosscutting concepts and propose only architecture-significant decisions for human acceptance.

state.description: Arc42MethodStateV1 bounded references shared by every arc42 Loop in the Root Run.

nodes.description: Design the smallest set of crosscutting concepts needed by approved quality scenarios.

work.task: Update arc42 section 8 with concrete crosscutting concepts linked to quality scenarios and building blocks. State applicability, implementation anchors and limits; avoid a generic concept catalog.

validation.task: Validate that each concept is necessary, quality-driven, linked to BB/QS IDs and concrete enough to guide implementation. Do not edit the concepts.

nodes.description: Identify significant decisions, create proposals only when justified and obtain human acceptance.

work.task: Assess unresolved design choices. Create or update a draft/review ADR proposal only when a choice is important, risky, expensive, hard to reverse or contentious. Never modify an accepted ADR silently; update section 9 only for actual records.

validation.task: Accept or reject each new architecture-significant ADR proposal, or confirm with evidence that no new ADR is required. Never approve an implicit change to an accepted ADR.

loops.description: Synchronize architecture indexes, traceability, glossary, status and initiative handoff, then obtain focused stakeholder review.

state.description: Arc42MethodStateV1 bounded references shared by every arc42 Loop in the Root Run.

nodes.description: Synchronize indexes, traceability, glossary, persistent status and initiative handoff without duplication.

work.task: Synchronize arc42 indexes, TRACEABILITY, glossary, STATUS and the initiative handoff. Resolve links and statuses from canonical owners, update only changed facts and avoid duplicating Goal/ADR/DESIGN or runtime content.

validation.task: Validate canonical ownership, frontmatter, stable IDs, links, trace completeness and absence of duplicated active sources. Do not edit the documents.

nodes.description: Prepare and review a concise stakeholder summary and implementation handoff.

work.task: Prepare an initiative review summary listing changes, Decisions, Assumptions, Findings, risks, Open questions, evidence and the next approved action. Link canonical sources instead of copying them.

validation.task: Review the architecture summary and handoff. Approve the next action or identify the exact capability/decision needing repair; do not approve unresolved WHAT/WHY or priority-1 evidence gaps.

loops.description: Plan and implement one bounded initiative, compare the diff with architecture and collect acceptance/conformance evidence.

state.description: Arc42MethodStateV1 bounded references shared by every arc42 Loop in the Root Run.

nodes.description: Create a bounded initiative PLAN traced to architecture and tests.

work.task: Create or update the initiative PLAN. Every step must reference in-scope REQ/QS/ADR/CON/BB/RT/DEP/test IDs, exact source areas, dependencies, risks, legacy removal and completion evidence. Do not grant release authority.

validation.task: Validate PLAN scope, ordering, dependencies, architecture trace and test/evidence coverage. Do not edit the plan.

nodes.description: Implement the approved bounded change and tests while surfacing architecture drift.

work.task: Implement the bounded PLAN steps and tests. Run relevant checks, remove in-scope legacy and compare discoveries against architecture. Update non-decision architecture within scope or request repair for a better solution; never hide drift or perform release/deploy/push/merge.

validation.task: Independently compare the diff and tests against the PLAN, QS, ADR, CON, BB and runtime/deployment references. Do not modify implementation or tests; request a measurable repair for any drift.

nodes.description: Collect acceptance/conformance evidence and obtain human implementation acceptance before any release.

work.task: Run or collect the PLAN's acceptance and conformance checks and update initiative EVIDENCE. Record exact commands/results, changed paths, stable IDs, limitations and unresolved priority-1 gaps without modifying the implementation under review.

validation.task: Accept or reject the implementation and evidence before any release request. Approval is implementation acceptance only and does not authorize release, deploy, rollback, merge or push.

loops.description: Evaluate implementation against measurable quality evidence and update risks, debt, drift, traceability, review and method health.

state.description: Arc42MethodStateV1 bounded references shared by every arc42 Loop in the Root Run.

nodes.description: Evaluate actual evidence against every in-scope measurable quality scenario.

work.task: Evaluate the initiative against each in-scope measurable quality scenario. Record pass/fail/blocked/missing evidence separately and update TRACEABILITY plus initiative REVIEW without inferring success from absent evidence.

validation.task: Validate every QS verdict against its exact measurable criterion and evidence reference. Do not change implementation, tests or verdict sources.

nodes.description: Assess risks, technical debt, architecture drift and decision fitness.

work.task: Analyze risk, technical debt, architecture drift, stale/contradictory documentation and whether relevant ADRs/concepts still achieve their intended quality response. Update section 11 and REVIEW only for evidence-backed Findings.

validation.task: Validate that each retained risk/debt/drift finding has concrete evidence, affected stable IDs, impact and an appropriate capability/outcome. Do not edit findings.

nodes.description: Update method health and derive only evidence-backed improvement actions and handoff.

work.task: Update METHOD-HEALTH from actual Validation FAILs, retries, repair targets, open questions, drift, evidence gaps and interventions. For any proposed method change record baseline, hypothesis, expected metric and later eval; require human approval for behavior changes.

validation.task: Validate that method-health changes come from cited evidence, preserve human approval boundaries and contain no preference-only churn. Do not modify evaluated records.

loops.description: Research authoritative technology and method evidence on schedule, record only material findings and route them through existing approval boundaries.

state.description: Arc42MethodStateV1 bounded references shared by every arc42 Loop in the Root Run.

nodes.description: Research dependencies, technologies, official advisories and repeated method evidence from primary sources.

work.task: Research current dependencies/technologies, official release notes/advisories, repeated validation failures, repair routes, document drift and test evidence. Use only authoritative primary sources; do not write externally or change code/config/behavior. If nothing material is found, make no semantic document change.

validation.task: Validate source authority, materiality, impact, stable QS/RISK/ADR/BB links and expected measurable improvement. Reject preference-only findings and document churn; do not edit research artifacts.

nodes.description: Record material findings and request the correct repair capability without changing method behavior.

work.task: For each material finding record impact, primary-source evidence, relevant QS/RISK/ADR/BB IDs and expected measurable improvement. Prepare a capability-based repair request when action is warranted. Do not change Loops, profiles, permissions, Goals, ADRs, instructions or skills.

validation.task: Validate that each action is evidence-based and routed by capability. Return needs_input for any proposed topology, permission, network, accepted decision, instruction or skill behavior change; do not apply it.

loops.description: Prepare, explicitly authorize, execute and verify a bounded release/deploy/rollback action without automatic invocation from development flow.

state.description: Arc42MethodStateV1-compatible release and evidence references for a separately authorized Root Run.

nodes.description: Prepare a bounded release plan and obtain exact human authorization before any external write.

work.task: Verify accepted implementation evidence and prepare a local release/deploy/rollback plan naming exact version, repository, environment, commands, checks and rollback intent. Do not perform any external write.

validation.task: Authorize or reject the exact named external actions, targets and limits. Implementation acceptance alone is not authorization. State separately whether release, deploy, rollback, merge or push is allowed; unmentioned actions remain forbidden.

nodes.description: Execute only the exact human-authorized release/deploy action and record external evidence.

work.task: Execute only the actions explicitly authorized by the preceding Human Validation and existing project release contract. Record exact commands, targets and results without secrets. Never merge or push unless separately named in the authorization.

validation.task: Validate external release/deploy evidence against the exact human authorization, idempotency, environment, permissions and rollback readiness. Do not perform or repair the external action.

nodes.description: Verify the authorized release and obtain the final human decision, including any separately authorized rollback.

work.task: Run the authorized health, smoke, acceptance and observability checks and record evidence. If rollback is needed but not explicitly authorized, return needs_input before performing it. Do not infer permission from failure.

validation.task: Accept or reject the release evidence and explicitly authorize any remaining rollback or external follow-up. Do not treat this gate as automatic merge or push permission.
